name: Servant
overview: The Scriptures portray servants in various roles, from Hagar, a handmaid given to Abram and Sarai, to trained servants who accompanied Abram in battle. Servanthood involved submission and was governed by divine instruction, as seen when the angel of the LORD commanded Hagar to return and submit to her mistress. These passages highlight the reality of servanthood in biblical times, emphasizing obedience and the social structures within households.
